Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project with its details, financials, dependencies, and change orders.

wbs.description: Work Breakdown Structure code for the project.

deliveryMethod.description: The delivery method used for the project (e.g., CMAR, DB, DBB).

status.description: The current status of the project.

currentPhase.description: The current design/construction phase of the project.

glCodeComputerEquipmentOver5k.description: GL Code for computer equipment over $5,000.

glCodeComputerEquipmentUnder5k.description: GL Code for computer equipment under $5,000.

glCodeNonComputerEquipmentOver5k.description: GL Code for non-computer equipment over $5,000.

glCodeNonComputerEquipmentUnder5k.description: GL Code for non-computer equipment under $5,000.

Financial.title: Financial
Financial.description: Represents the financial details for a specific discipline within a project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the financial record.

discipline.description: The IT discipline associated with the financial record.

item.description: The specific item within the discipline.

baseline.description: The baseline cost estimate for the item.

shoppingCart.description: The actual cost from the shopping cart for the item.

po.description: The purchase order number for the item.

vendor.description: The vendor for the financial item.

Dependency.title: Dependency
Dependency.description: Represents a project dependency and its associated dates and status.

task.description: The name of the dependency task.

gcMilestoneDate.description: The General Contractor milestone date for the dependency.

itTargetDate.description: The IT target date for the dependency.

ChangeOrder.title: ChangeOrder
ChangeOrder.description: Represents a change order for a project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the change order.

description.description: A description of the change order.

amount.description: The cost of the change order.

status.description: The status of the change order.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Stores project details. The 'projectId' is used as the document ID.

/projects/{projectId}/financials/{financ.description: Stores financial records for a specific project. Includes denormalized 'projectId' for authorization independence.

/projects/{projectId}/dependencies/{depe.description: Stores project dependencies. Includes denormalized 'projectId' for authorization independence.

/projects/{projectId}/changeOrders/{chan.description: Stores change orders for a specific project. Includes denormalized 'projectId' for authorization independence.
